moment: Hogwarts castle across the Black Lake at night, floating candles, a broomstick drifting in: arrival at Hogwarts
why: Unmistakable Hogwarts silhouette on a cliff over a lake, the Great Hall's floating candles brought outdoors, and a classic witch's broom.

moment: Virus's 'astronaut pen' in its velvet case on a lecture desk, with a stopwatch, in a classroom
why: An engraved heirloom pen presented in a box in an Indian college classroom, plus the stopwatch, reads as the pen-that-writes-in-space handover. The stopwatch also fits Virus's timed routines.

moment: Red-sky frontier ranch at dusk, with a trail of X waypoints along the dirt path
why: Lone oak, homestead, split-rail fence and mountains under a blood-red sky is RDR2's palette and key-art language. The X markers read as map or bounty waypoints.

moment: Frontier-town notice board covered in pinned wanted and bounty posters, with a blank one in front
why: Weathered timber board, tacked aged paper and a dusty main street behind it suggest the game's bounty and wanted boards.

moment: Open sketchbook with a taped note and a pencil-drawn curved track or ladder
why: Generic designer's notebook. The curved track might be a railway sketch, but nothing points clearly to a film or game.

moment: Hogwarts Express crossing the Glenfinnan Viaduct through the Highlands
why: A red steam engine on that curved stone viaduct beside a loch is the iconic Hogwarts Express shot.

moment: Same red-tinted ranch at sunset, with X markers scattered in the sky
why: Same western-homestead key-art look and red grade. The X marks feel like target or map markers.

moment: Ghost ship in fog behind a gold-ruled treasure map: island outline, dotted trail, X marks the spot
why: Tattered galleon at night plus a hand-drawn treasure map with an X and a compass star.

moment: Golden-hour river valley seen through giant cut-out letterforms (a title reveal)
why: Warm western valley with oaks and a winding river matches the game's Heartlands. Only part of it shows through the mask, so I'm less sure.

moment: Empty engineering-college lecture hall, with a quadcopter drawn in chalk on the board
why: Brutalist Indian campus lecture hall with stone walls, wooden benches and a sunlit colonnade, plus the drone. It recalls the film's college and its camera-drone subplot.

moment: A saddled horse grazing in a golden valley at sunset, river winding below
why: A lone saddled horse in open western grassland at magic hour is RDR2's signature mood.

moment: Enchanted night-sky ceiling full of floating candles, with broomstick line-drawings
why: Floating candles against a starfield is the Great Hall ceiling. The fletched lines look like broomsticks.

moment: Moonlit harbour with tall ships at anchor, and a compass-to-X treasure route with a skull below
why: A colonial port at night (Port Royal or Tortuga feel), plus compass, skull and X, is pirate-adventure shorthand.

moment: Wooden board of pinned, weathered notices (bounty board), one fresh blank sheet in front
why: Same frontier bounty-board idea, but less context here; it could be any western.

moment: Yellow scooter parked on the shore of Pangong Lake at sunset: the finale
why: A high-altitude Ladakh lake with bare mountains and a yellow scooter on the pebbles is the film's famous ending location and prop.

moment: Homemade camera quadcopter flying over the college quad
why: Hand-built drone with an exposed board, battery and camera, flying past concrete colonnades on an Indian campus. It recalls the drone scene.

moment: Same homemade quadcopter over a campus lawn and pergola walkway
why: Same drone and Indian brutalist-campus setting as J016.

moment: Stormy open sea with a breaking teal wave, plus the compass-to-X treasure route
why: Storm at sea and a treasure map with skull and X. The pirate cue comes mostly from the map graphic.

moment: Astronaut pen in its velvet box beside a stopwatch on the professor's desk
why: Same pen-and-stopwatch still life as J002, in a classroom with a chalkboard behind.

moment: Swarm of floating candles in a night sky, one candle picked out by teal focus brackets
why: Floating candles say Great Hall. The bracket framing feels like a game HUD target, which mixes the reference a little.

moment: Lecture hall: a chalk quadcopter and a gear-and-flight-path sketch on the board
why: Same Indian-campus lecture hall with the drone drawing as J010.

moment: Sunset horizon with a lone ship and a glowing teal wake, above a compass-to-X treasure route
why: A sailing ship on the horizon plus a compass, skull and X treasure trail.

moment: The Marauder's Map unfolding: parchment with corridors, compass roses, a banner, and footprints walking
why: Folded parchment with inked corridors and moving footprints is clearly the Marauder's Map.

moment: The Black Pearl, with black tattered sails under a storm-lit moon, and a dotted gold trail ending at an X
why: Ragged black sails on a dark galleon at night is the Black Pearl, plus the X-marks-the-spot trail.

moment: Pangong Lake with the yellow scooter, and a row of sketched boxes with the last one circled
why: Same Ladakh lake-and-yellow-scooter finale as J015. The overlay graphic is unclear.

moment: Floating candles in a starry sky, broomstick line-drawings in rows
why: Floating candles again. The broom-like strokes support a Hogwarts reading.

moment: Night sea under storm clouds, a bioluminescent wave rolling in, a lone lit ship on the horizon
why: A lone square-rigged ship at night on a dark sea suggests pirates. The glowing wave could equally be Life of Pi, so I'm only moderately confident.

moment: Gang camp at sunset: wall tents, covered wagon, hitched horses, cookfire, lake and mountains
why: The Van der Linde camp almost exactly (Horseshoe Overlook vibe), with game-UI corner brackets on the frame.

moment: Same camp at dusk: lantern-lit wall tent, covered wagon, pot over the fire
why: Same RDR2-style camp composition.

moment: Parchment on a wet stone floor among floating candles, with dark cracks spreading and glowing footprints
why: Floating candles, a castle outside the windows, and a parchment with footprints point to Hogwarts and the Marauder's Map. The spreading black veins suggest dark magic.

moment: Camp at night: two tents and a small fire under the mountains
why: A night campsite in the wilderness fits the RDR2 camp sequence, but it's generic on its own.

moment: The Black Pearl under the moon, and Jack Sparrow's compass with a line dropping down
why: Black tattered sails, a ghostly galleon, and an ornate octagonal compass like Jack's.

moment: The Marauder's Map up close: corridors, footprints walking, a doorway marker
why: Inked footprints moving along parchment corridors.

moment: The dark ghost ship, Jack's compass, and a dotted waypoint trail down the centre
why: Same Black Pearl image (dimmed) and the same compass motif.

moment: The Great Hall at night: floating candles, four long house tables, the high table
why: Floating candles over long tables in a gothic hall is the Great Hall.

moment: Sunlit classroom chalkboard with a drone sketch and a row of bars, one highlighted
why: The drone drawing ties it to the 3 Idiots set. The arched stone window also reads a bit Hogwarts, so I'm not sure.

moment: Open sketchbook: red rule, taped note, a wireframe grid crossed out
why: A designer's notebook with no film or game cue.

moment: Night sea under storm clouds, a glowing teal wave, a distant lit ship
why: Same as J027: the lone sailing ship suggests pirates; the glowing wave is ambiguous.

moment: The Great Hall with floating candles and the long tables set with gold goblets and plates
why: Iconic Great Hall composition.
